description: Create, delete or activate ZFS boot environments.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Associate a description with a new boot environment. This option is available only on Solarish platforms.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Specifies if the unmount should be forced. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: mountpoint
parameters.description: Path where to mount the ZFS boot environment.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Create the datasets for new BE with specific ZFS properties. Multiple options can be specified. This option is available only on Solarish platforms.

parameters.name: snapshot
parameters.description: If specified, the new boot environment is cloned from the given snapshot or inactive boot environment.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Create or delete ZFS boot environment. Choices: "absent" "activated" "mounted" "present" ← (default) "unmounted"

examples:
- name: Create ZFS boot environment
  community.general.beadm:
    name: upgrade-be
    state: present

- name: Create ZFS boot environment from existing inactive boot environment
  community.general.beadm:
    name: upgrade-be
    snapshot: be@old
    state: present

- name: Create ZFS boot environment with compression enabled and description "upgrade"
  community.general.beadm:
    name: upgrade-be
    options: "compression=on"
    description: upgrade
    state: present

- name: Delete ZFS boot environment
  community.general.beadm:
    name: old-be
    state: absent

- name: Mount ZFS boot environment on /tmp/be
  community.general.beadm:
    name: BE
    mountpoint: /tmp/be
    state: mounted

- name: Unmount ZFS boot environment
  community.general.beadm:
    name: BE
    state: unmounted

- name: Activate ZFS boot environment
  community.general.beadm:
    name: upgrade-be
    state: activated

return_values.name: description
return_values.description: BE description. Returned: always Sample: "Upgrade from 9.0 to 10.0"

return_values.name: force
return_values.description: If forced action is wanted. Returned: always Sample: false

return_values.name: options
return_values.description: BE additional options. Returned: always Sample: "compression=on"

return_values.name: snapshot
return_values.description: ZFS snapshot to create BE from. Returned: always Sample: "rpool/ROOT/oi-hipster@fresh"

return_values.name: state
return_values.description: State of the target. Returned: always Sample: "present"
